rows.label: Contribution directe territoriale (CDT)
rows.value: Contribution directe territoriale (CDT): a local income tax on income from professional activity carried out in the TAAF, withheld at source by employers and paid directly to the territorial administration; created by arrêté n° 2001-29 of the administrateur supérieur, it replaced the earlier local tax collected by assessment roll
rows.note: The BOFiP page gives no start date for the 2026 figures; stored from 1 January 2026. The arrêté itself (recueil des actes administratifs des TAAF) was not read.

source.title: BOFiP BOI-RSA-GEO-30: Régimes particuliers, personnes affectées dans les Terres australes et antarctiques françaises (TAAF) (version en vigueur du 06/05/2021)

rows.label: CDT: single rate
rows.note: income from professional activity in the TAAF, withheld at source (single rate). Rate stated in a 2016 ministerial answer to a written question (Assemblée nationale, 14th legislature); the arrêté in force was not read and no current official page states the rate. Under review until the TAAF's recueil des actes is read.

source.title: Question écrite n° 96031 (14e législature): fiscalité des bases françaises en Antarctique, réponse du ministère de l'Économie et des Finances (JO 2016)

rows.label: CDT: rate for taxpayers domiciled in La Réunion
rows.note: income from professional activity in the TAAF of taxpayers whose tax domicile is in La Réunion. Same 2016 ministerial answer. Under review until the arrêté in force is read.

source.title: Question écrite n° 96031 (14e législature): fiscalité des bases françaises en Antarctique, réponse du ministère de l'Économie et des Finances (JO 2016)

rows.label: CDT and French income tax
rows.value: Keeping a French tax domicile (CGI art. 4 B): the CDT withheld for a year is credited against the French income tax due on the same income (form 2042 C), on a certificate from the territorial administration. Not domiciled in France: TAAF earnings are not subject to French income tax, and the CDT is never credited against French tax on French-source income
